items.headline: 543-apartment project proposed at 220 Humboldt Court in Moffett Park
items.summary: The November 23 Planning Commission study session agenda listed TruAmerica's proposal to replace a 50,000-square-foot office building with an eight-story, 356-unit rental building and a five-story building of 187 affordable units. The plan includes a three-level garage with 554 unbundled parking spaces on a 3.55-acre site.

items.headline: Nine townhomes proposed on Golden Oak Court single-family lot
items.summary: The November 23 study session agenda listed a proposal to demolish a one-story house at 760 Golden Oak Court and build nine townhome-style condominiums in two three-story buildings. The 0.35-acre site is zoned medium density residential (R-3), and the project would be subdivided into three lots including a common lot.

items.headline: Primrose preschool for up to 192 children proposed on E. Homestead Road
items.summary: A hearing continued from November 9 was listed on the November 23 Planning Commission agenda for a 16,000-square-foot, two-story childcare and preschool at 855 E. Homestead Road. It would replace a vacant commercial building, and the plan includes a new eight-foot masonry wall along the western property line and part of the southern property line.

items.headline: Planning Commission agenda: 316-unit apartments at 400 Saratoga Avenue golf course
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a recommendation on a General Plan amendment and rezone for a five-story, 316-unit apartment building at 400 Saratoga Avenue. The project would also reconfigure the existing nine-hole golf course and dedicate land for a public park, and an EIR was prepared and circulated for public review.

items.headline: Townhomes and duplex with commercial space proposed near Civic Center Drive
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed action on a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes covering 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The item cites a CEQA exemption under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Gymnastics facility proposed in Corvin Drive warehouse
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a conditional use permit to let 7,116 square feet of an existing 16,576-square-foot warehouse at 3051 Corvin Drive be used as a gymnastics facility.

items.headline: Appeal filed over second-story addition on Rita Court
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed an appeal of a Development Review Officer's approval of a 517-square-foot first-floor and 1,000-square-foot second-floor addition to a single-story home at 2261 Rita Court. The lot is 6,272 square feet.

items.headline: 69-stall parking lot proposed at 2740 Scott Boulevard
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a conditional use permit for a 69-stall surface parking lot at 2740 Scott Boulevard. The request also includes architectural review to completely demolish the existing vacant structures and a minor use permit for offsite parking.
